post.summary: Submit a message template to Meta
post.description: Validates and stores the template as `draft`, then submits it to Meta asynchronously. Status becomes `pending` once Meta accepts the submission and `approved`/`rejected` only after Meta's decision. Only `approved` templates can be sent. Meshio policy runs first: content that breaks the policy is refused with 422 `POLICY_BLOCKED` (`details.reasons`); content that needs a human look is stored as `pending_review` and is only submitted to Meta after a Meshio operator approves it (a refusal sets `rejected` with the reason).

delete.description: Deletes the template on Meta (best-effort) and locally. Templates already used in message history are kept with status `deleted` (soft delete).

post.summary: Sync templates of a channel's WhatsApp account from Meta
Resubmit a draft template to Meta
post.description: Re-enqueues the Meta submission of a template still in `draft` (for example after a temporary Meta failure or while the channel was not active). Returns 409 if the template is no longer a draft.
